article.title: Google開放Connected Apps平台預覽，讓品牌服務接入Search與Gemini
article.title_en: Google previews a unified Connected Apps platform for Search and Gemini
article.summary: Google於10月28日公布Connected Apps Platform預覽，讓開發者集中提交及管理Search與Gemini內的應用程式；存取權限將分階段開放。
article.summary_en: Google announced a preview of its Connected Apps Platform on October 28, giving developers one place to submit and manage integrations for Search and Gemini. Access is opening in phases.
article.why: 品牌需要評估的不只搜尋內容曝光，亦包括消費者能否在AI介面直接使用服務。應用程式接入涉及產品、資料及驗證流程，適合由行銷與技術團隊共同評估。
article.why_en: Brands can assess both discovery and whether customers can use their services inside an AI interface. Marketing and product teams should evaluate the integration and authentication requirements together.
article.next_step: 先選一項明確服務，檢視MCP接入、登入授權及成效事件，再向Google確認預覽資格與市場。
article.next_step_en: Choose one service, review MCP integration, authentication and conversion events, then confirm preview eligibility and markets with Google.
highlights: 開發者可用雲端MCP伺服器或透過AppFunctions APIs的Android MCP接入，再經Google Connected Console測試及提交。
發布前可選Search、Gemini或兩者；Google表示可追蹤流量、延遲及錯誤率。
Adobe等合作夥伴的Gemini整合已推出，相關Search整合預計未來數週跟進。
highlights_en: Developers can integrate cloud-hosted MCP servers or Android MCP through AppFunctions APIs, then test and submit in Google Connected Console.
Developers choose Search, Gemini or both before review; Google describes traffic, latency and error reporting.
Integrations including Adobe are live in Gemini, with Search availability planned over the coming weeks.
article.detail:
Google於10月28日公布Connected Apps Platform預覽，讓開發者集中提交及管理Search與Gemini內的應用程式；存取權限將分階段開放。

開發者可用雲端MCP伺服器或透過AppFunctions APIs的Android MCP接入，再經Google Connected Console測試及提交。

發布前可選Search、Gemini或兩者；Google表示可追蹤流量、延遲及錯誤率。

Adobe等合作夥伴的Gemini整合已推出，相關Search整合預計未來數週跟進。

品牌需要評估的不只搜尋內容曝光，亦包括消費者能否在AI介面直接使用服務。應用程式接入涉及產品、資料及驗證流程，適合由行銷與技術團隊共同評估。

先選一項明確服務，檢視MCP接入、登入授權及成效事件，再向Google確認預覽資格與市場。

這是分階段預覽；公告未列出完整市場名單，亦未承諾接入必定帶來流量或成交。
article.detail_en:
Google announced a preview of its Connected Apps Platform on October 28, giving developers one place to submit and manage integrations for Search and Gemini. Access is opening in phases.

Developers can integrate cloud-hosted MCP servers or Android MCP through AppFunctions APIs, then test and submit in Google Connected Console.

Developers choose Search, Gemini or both before review; Google describes traffic, latency and error reporting.

Integrations including Adobe are live in Gemini, with Search availability planned over the coming weeks.

Brands can assess both discovery and whether customers can use their services inside an AI interface. Marketing and product teams should evaluate the integration and authentication requirements together.

Choose one service, review MCP integration, authentication and conversion events, then confirm preview eligibility and markets with Google.

This is a phased preview. The announcement does not provide a full market list or guarantee traffic or sales.
